supplement: The 95% intervals below are pointwise, not adjusted for multiple comparisons; Holm adjustment applies to the reported p-values.

The reported 95% intervals are pointwise, not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Holm adjustment was applied separately to the 14 ChemIDBench tests and four XSTest tests; the exploratory DualChem human-assistance p-value is unadjusted.
Recalculating agreement from available annotations does not replace independent expert checks of label validity.

Raw agreement between the two released human annotations was calculated across all 450 responses per configuration, including safe and unsafe prompts; it is not a chance-corrected coefficient.
